reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides cross-session memory by recalling scoped GoodMemory entries before model steps and writing completed exchanges back to GoodMemory.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话记忆，在模型步骤前召回相关 GoodMemory 内容，并在回合完成后写回选定的对话文本。
summaries.en: Provides cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness by recalling relevant GoodMemory entries before model steps and writing selected completed-turn text back afterward.

capabilities: Recalls relevant durable memory before DeepSeek Harness model steps
Writes selected human and final assistant text to GoodMemory after completed turns
Stores memory in SQLite through a managed local sidecar or connects to an external HTTP bridge
Uses scoped identifiers and bearer-token authentication for external mode
